Contract CoCoMESystem::receiveOrderedProduct(orderID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderID)
	precondition:
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(obs)
	postcondition:
		obs.OrderStatus = RECEIVED and
		obs.ContainedEntries->forAll(o: OrderEntry|o.Item.StockNumber = o.Item.StockNumber+o.Quantity) and
		result = true
}
